settings.heading: Simple, Consistent Wellness for Everyday Life.
settings.body: We believe wellness is supported by the choices people make each day: making time for rest, creating space for relaxation, maintaining healthy routines, and paying attention to personal well-being. The Healthy Sleep Space approach is designed to complement these everyday choices with a simple, noninvasive way to create a personal wellness experience at home, while resting, or during quiet moments throughout the day.
settings.disclaimer: General wellness only. Not medical advice or medical care.

settings.text: Support a positive sense of personal vitality

settings.heading: Wellness Develops Through Consistent Habits
settings.body: Wellness is not defined by a single product or activity. It develops through consistent habits that support how people rest, relax, move, think, and care for themselves. Healthy Sleep Space products are intended to complement — not replace — healthy sleep habits, balanced nutrition, appropriate physical activity, and other positive lifestyle choices. Our approach encourages you to:

settings.title: Rest and Sleep Routines
settings.text: A consistent schedule, a comfortable environment, and time to wind down can help support healthy sleep habits. Our wellness products are designed to fit naturally into personal bedtime and relaxation routines.

settings.title: Relaxation and Stress Management
settings.text: Creating quiet moments during the day can encourage relaxation and help people manage everyday stress. Our approach makes room for calm, reflection, and personal time.

settings.title: Personal Energy and Vitality
settings.text: Healthy routines that include adequate rest, movement, relaxation, and self-care can contribute to an overall sense of well-being. Our products are designed to complement these routines.

settings.title: Mental Focus
settings.text: A comfortable environment and consistent healthy habits may help people feel more prepared for activities that require attention, learning, and organization.

settings.title: A Comfortable Wellness Environment
settings.text: A quiet, organized, and welcoming environment can make it easier to pause, relax, and maintain personal wellness practices.

Technology Centered on Your Routine
settings.body: The Healthy Sleep Space wellness experience is centered on Low-Intensity Photon-Generators (LIPG), developed for noninvasive use as part of a personal wellness routine. We describe our technology using clear product information and measured physical characteristics — never as a tool for diagnosing or treating medical conditions.

settings.title: Support Your Routine with Healthy Choices
settings.text: Combine your wellness practice with adequate rest, balanced nutrition, appropriate physical activity, and other healthy lifestyle choices.
